title: Defence in depth: layers that hold each other up

videos.script: Every control fails sometimes. A password leaks. A rule has a typo. Somebody clicks the link. {{fails}} So the question is not how to build one perfect control. It is what still stands when one of them gives way. {{stands}} That is defence in depth: several layers, each able to stop what got past the one before. {{layers}} In the lab you will test it the way a defender should, by assuming each layer has already failed. A stranger with no password. Then a stranger with a real, leaked password. Then a portal tricked into reading files. {{test}} And at the end, a log that saw all of it. {{log}} You will also see when two layers are really one, and why that matters. {{one}}
